integrity: The finite canonical census is reproducible from a standalone exact logical-type recurrence and an independently coded direct three-round game. Infinite coverage follows from the supplied path and Cartesian-product lemmas.
scientific_limitations: Only undirected simple Cartesian products of two nonempty finite paths, in pure adjacency/equality language, at quantifier rank three.
Not a classification at higher rank or with built-in coordinate directions, orders, constants or counting quantifiers.
Independent scientific audit not performed; possible overlap with unindexed historical work remains.
title: Twelve rank-three theories of finite rectangular grid graphs, with a sharp ten-vertex kernel
